item.subject: science
item.stem:
Ritu adds vegetable peels and cow dung to a closed pit. After a few weeks the waste has turned into dark, nutrient-rich manure. Bacteria, fungi, and viruses can be found in soil.

Which statement best explains the change?

options.A: Bacteria and fungi break the plant and animal waste down into simpler, nutrient-rich manure.
options.B: The waste becomes manure on its own, and then microorganisms arrive to feed on it.
options.C: Viruses in the soil break the waste down into nutrient-rich manure.
options.D: Fresh peels that look dark are already nutrient-rich manure.
